entries.values: Path of a JSON file. The top level is an object or an array. A bare array of token ids is the default script. In an object, a key is a prompt key such as "9707,1879" or the word default, and the reserved key rendered_at holds a date. Each script is an array of token ids or an object with tokens, num_logprobs and logprobs (src/tron/scheduler/golden_tokens.cpp:299-335; examples at t/t_rinzler_proxy.cpp:334-335).

entries.default: Unset: the loader logs an error, and every generation throws std::runtime_error 'proxy: golden map unavailable'. An empty value is tried as a file name and fails in the same way.
entries.effect: Names the file from which rinzler_proxy takes its output tokens. Generation in rinzler_proxy emits these scripted tokens instead of running a model (README.proxy.md:19).
entries.name: TRON_GOLDEN_TOKENS
entries.notes: The variable and the file are read again for every generation, so the file can change while the proxy runs. A file that cannot be read, is not JSON, or has a wrong shape gives the same per-request error (src/tron/scheduler/proxy.cpp:415). The file format is described at h/tron/scheduler/golden_tokens.hpp:102 and in README.proxy.md. t/t_rinzler_proxy.cpp sets the variable at 9 sites in total, so there are 10 setter sites with t/proxy/rzproxy/launch.py:209; 4 are listed. rinzler_proxy is a stand-in for rinzler that is used for tests without an FPGA or model weights (README.proxy.md:21-22).

rederive.audience_reason: It is the main input of rinzler_proxy. The task lists rinzler_proxy as a deployed program and CMake installs it (src/CMakeLists.txt:196). In practice rinzler_proxy is test equipment, so test is also defensible.
rederive.default: Unset: the loader logs the error proxy: TRON_GOLDEN_TOKENS unset; every generation will throw until it is set to a file with a non-empty "default" (src/tron/scheduler/golden_tokens.cpp:303 and :309-312). stream_generate then throws std::runtime_error proxy: golden map unavailable: <cause> (src/tron/scheduler/proxy.cpp:414-415). The process keeps running.
rederive.effect: Names the file from which rinzler_proxy takes the tokens that it emits in place of running a model. The variable and the file are read again for every generation, so a change to the file takes effect at the next request without a restart.
rederive.empty_value: The empty text is tried as a file name. The open fails, the loader logs cannot open TRON_GOLDEN_TOKENS file ''; every generation will throw until it is readable (src/tron/scheduler/golden_tokens.cpp:313-317), and each generation throws the same error as for unset.
rederive.how_to_check: Info log line for each generation: proxy: prompt key <key> -> <N> golden tokens (src/tron/scheduler/proxy.cpp:504). A failed load logs proxy: <cause> at error level (src/tron/scheduler/golden_tokens.cpp:303).
rederive.interactions: When the file has a rendered_at entry, RZ_SYSTEM_START_DATE must be set to the same text. Otherwise the generation throws (src/tron/scheduler/golden_tokens.cpp:223-244, called at src/tron/scheduler/proxy.cpp:418). Only rinzler_proxy links the proxy scheduler (src/CMakeLists.txt:180-190). No command-line flag.
rederive.invalid_value: A file that cannot be opened, is not valid JSON, or has the wrong shape gives one error log line per generation with the cause (src/tron/scheduler/golden_tokens.cpp:313-334) and the same throw. A prompt with no matching key and no default entry throws proxy: no golden tokens for prompt key <key> (src/tron/scheduler/proxy.cpp:515-518). The process keeps running in all these cases.
rederive.name: TRON_GOLDEN_TOKENS

entries.default: Unset: no profile is written. An empty value is not treated as unset. The open of the empty path then fails and a warning is logged.
entries.effect: Names the file that receives a text histogram of the live DMA heap allocations, grouped by size class and by caller address. The arena allocator writes it when an allocation fails for lack of memory (tag OOM, src/system/heap_v2.cpp:523).
entries.name: TRON_HEAP_PROFILE_PATH
entries.notes: The arena allocator writes nothing unless its shadow map is on (TRON_HEAP_SHADOW=1 or --heap-shadow). The check is at src/system/heap_v2.cpp:914, before the variable is read. Each dump is appended, so the file grows. If the file cannot be opened the code logs a warning and continues. The caller addresses are raw. The comment at src/system/heap.cpp:210-213 says to resolve them with addr2line. t/t_heap_v2.cpp sets the variable at 2 sites (lines 1385 and 1463).

rederive.audience_reason: It is a diagnostic dump for heap fragmentation research (h/system/heap_v2.hpp:6-10). It needs the shadow map, which is off by default.
rederive.effect: When the arena allocator cannot serve an allocation from the DMA heap, it appends a text histogram of the live allocations to this file. The histogram is grouped by size class and by caller address. Each block starts with === OOM n_live=<count> === (src/system/heap_v2.cpp:956).
rederive.empty_value: Not the same as unset. The histogram is built, the open of the empty path fails, and the warning heap_v2::dump_profile: could not open <path> for append is logged (src/system/heap_v2.cpp:949-953).
rederive.how_to_check: No log line prints the path. The warning at src/system/heap_v2.cpp:951 shows a path that cannot be opened. A successful dump adds a block that starts with === OOM n_live= to the file.
rederive.interactions: Nothing is written unless the shadow map is on (TRON_HEAP_SHADOW=1 or --heap-shadow). The arena allocator must be in use: TRON_USE_ARENA_ALLOCATOR unset with the build default ON (src/system/CMakeLists.txt:86-88), or set to 1. Each dump is appended, so the file grows. The caller addresses are raw. The source says to resolve them with addr2line (src/system/heap.cpp:210-213).
rederive.invalid_value: A path that cannot be opened for append gives the same warning. The program continues.
